newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the Panhandle area late Thursday. Limited test on slaughter steers closed $1.00 lower, slaughter heifers were not tested.
Feedlots reported limited inquiry from buyers. Sales

reported on 1,700 slaughter steers; 101,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 60 loads or 2,000 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 16,800 formulated and 1,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Wk to date: 101,600 Week Ago: 106,600 Year Ago: 103,700
